description: Confirms that dreamina-canvas-use is the only implicit Canvas Skill and routes to the smallest applicable chain, reporting every lifecycle stage.
expectations: dreamina-canvas-use is the only dreamina-canvas-* Skill with allow_implicit_invocation == true
Every final response surfaces: saved draft id, quoted amount, user approval, submission acceptance, terminal completion, verified artifact
Routing selects the smallest applicable chain (does not call every Skill)
The end-to-end Skill does not duplicate global flags, exit codes, model catalogs, or node schemas
Spend is never approved on the user's behalf
submitId is forwarded from dreamina-canvas-quote-and-run, not minted here
tokens, signed URLs, cookies, creditConfirmationToken never appear in any response or log
